def f(g):
    h=len(g);w=len(g[0]);bg=Counter(c for r in g for c in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=clusters8(g,bg)
    shapes=[set(c_) for c_ in cs if len(c_)>2]
    singles=[c_[0] for c_ in cs if len(c_)==1]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for sy,sx in singles:
        scol=g[sy][sx];found=False
        for shape in shapes:
            for (a,b) in shape:
                if g[a][b]!=scol: continue
                # horizontal mirror about vertical axis through anchor col b, then translate anchor -> (sy,sx)
                dy,dx=sy-a,sx-b
                ok=True
                for (y,x) in shape:
                    ny,nx=dy+y,2*b-x+dx
                    if not(0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w) or (out[ny][nx]!=bg and (ny,nx)!=(sy,sx)):
                        ok=False;break
                    out[ny][nx]=g[y][x]
                if ok: found=True;break
            if found:break
    return out
